name: Streamline Cleaning
summary: Removes spurious streamlines from a tractogram with length, loop (angle and QuickBundles) and scilpy outlier filtering, plus optional Purifibre refinement, and outputs a cleaned .tck.
description: Runs filter_spurious_streamlines.sh in a scilpy/MRtrix3 container: optional Purifibre first pass, length filtering, loop filtering, scilpy outlier rejection and optional Purifibre final pass. If a step fails the pipeline continues from the last valid track. Use it to clean a single bundle or tractogram before tractometry; for a set of tracts use the Multiple Tracts version.

inputs.description: Tractogram or single bundle to clean (.tck).
Reference anatomical image passed to the scilpy steps.

parameters.description: Minimum streamline length; shorter streamlines are removed (0 if empty).
Maximum streamline length; longer streamlines are removed.
Maximum turning angle used for loop rejection.
QuickBundles distance threshold for loop filtering.
scilpy outlier rejection alpha (scilpy default 0.6; README recommends 0.3-0.4).
Skip the scilpy outlier rejection step.
Percentage of streamlines Purifibre removes in a final pass (empty to skip).
Number of threads for loop detection.

citations.text: Renauld E, et al. Tractography analysis with the scilpy toolbox. Aperture Neuro (2026).
Aydogan DB. Fiber coupling (FICO) measure using anisotropic smoothing of track orientation density images for tractogram filtering. ISMRM 2022.
Hayashi S, et al. brainlife.io: a decentralized and open-source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. Nature Methods (2024).

failure_modes.fix: Check that the track input contains a .tck file.
